dedupe_keys.name: estonian topographic database etak national 1 10 000 vector base data with roads railways buildings utility lines and hydrography

description: The Estonian Topographic Database (Eesti topograafia andmekogu, ETAK) is the national topographic vector database that, with the cadastre, forms the basis of Estonia's land information system. Contents: points, lines and polygons for the whole country, including roads and streets, railways, buildings and other structures, power lines and other utility lines, hydrography, land cover and place features; every object has a unique id that links it to the Road Register, the Register of Construction Works, the Environmental Register, the Address Register and the Place Names Register, and object history is kept. Producer: Maa- ja Ruumiamet, which updates the data in-house. Coverage: all of Estonia at 1:10,000, settlements at 1:5,000, with a generalised 1:250,000 product and historical vector versions. Format and access: nationwide downloads in Esri GDB, Shapefile, MapInfo TAB, GeoPackage, DGN and DWG, a separate buildings extract, WFS services for ETAK and derived layers listed in the national metadata catalogue, and a record search; the files are refreshed weekly. Free under the board's open data licence, which asks users to cite the source and date. Caveats: layer and field names and domain values are in Estonian, explained in a separate data model document; utility networks are shown as topographic features, not as a full network model with attributes from operators. Simulation uses: base layers for road and rail network graphs, building exposure, and hazard overlays such as flood or storm studies across Estonia. Related records: the Estonian 3D building models (data-estonia-3d-building-models-maa-ja-ruumiamet) and the building register (data-estonia-ehitisregister-building-register) add building detail.
